 Watch: Enzo Maresca’s press conference after Forest defeat 
 City Studios 
 Sat 07 Nov 2026, 20:50 
 Share 
 Enzo Maresca spoke to the media after our 3-1 defeat at Nottingham Forest. 
 Match Report 
 City fall to disappointing defeat at Forest 
 And you can watch the press conference in the video player above.
 City went two-down early on courtesy of Jair Cunha and Liam Delap goals.
 Rayan Cherki halved the arrears early in the second half with a precision half-volley.
 But Delap’s second sealed victory for the Tricky Trees.
 Maresca spoke to journalists in the wake of that City Ground loss.
 He was disappointed with the lack of intensity of his team in the first half and how losing duels set the tone in that opening period.
 The manager was happy with the second half fightback which looked at times when it could lead to a comeback.
 But he stressed it came too late in the day after the frustrating first half.
 He also spoke of staying calm and balanced, with three defeats coming after seven victories.
 Maresca also updated on his decision to withdraw Joško Gvardiol and Marc Guéhi at the break and explained what his approach will be now heading into the international break.
 Check out the manager’s briefing in the video player above.
 City v Fulham: Tickets on general sale
 Don’t miss out on our Premier League clash against Fulham with tickets now on general sale.
 The game between the Blues v the Cottagers takes place at the Etihad Stadium on Saturday 21 November with a 12:30 (UK) kick-off.
 Enzo Maresca’s men had an unblemished record on home soil – four wins from four games - in the Premier League before the frustrating tight loss to Brighton last time out.
 So the players will be eager to return to winning ways when Álvaro Arbeloa’s Londoners head to Manchester for this one.
 Supporters can purchase up to four tickets – with three additional for Season Ticket Members!
 Meanwhile, hospitality is available from just £130 in City Hall, housed within our new Pep Guardiola Stand.
 But there’s a range of packages available to suit all needs, whether a special occasion for a loved one or for something professional for clients.
